name: How long does window installation typically take?
description: Window installation usually takes 1-3 days for a full house, or a single day for a few windows, depending on project complexity.

mainEntity.name: How long does window installation typically take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of window installation depends on the number and type of windows, as well as the complexity of the project. A typical full house window replacement can often be completed within one to three days. For a few windows, installation might take a single day. We aim to work efficiently while maintaining high quality, and we'll provide a more precise timeline after assessing your specific needs.
